name: min_external_contributors
description: Distinct non-maintainer humans who opened an issue or PR or commented

name: min_active_days
description: Distinct days with at least one non-bot event

name: min_evidence_points
description: External responses plus resolved external PRs needed before a repo can be ranked

name: min_components
description: Score components a repo must have evidence for

name: merge_rate_prior_strength
description: Pseudo-count of PRs that shrinks small-sample merge rates toward the global rate

name: min_response_seconds
description: Actions sooner than this after creation are treated as automation and do not count as a response
